$comment: What CI proves, stage by stage. Every job in .github/workflows/ci.yml except Plan, Behavior matrix and Release is a leg here, and every leg records a verdict. The Behavior matrix job renders this file with those verdicts and fails when a leg failed or never ran. Gaps are cells of the behavior matrix that nothing proves yet; they are listed so they show up on every run instead of being forgotten. AgentUp.Architecture.Tests keeps this file and ci.yml in step. Definition: docs/developer-guide/repo/ci.md.
